However, since y is the most popular choice, it is likely to fill up quickly, and I might not get a chance to propose there if I am rejected from my first two choices.

4. My last choice is school w, where I have the highest priority rank of 1. If all else fails, I am guaranteed acceptance here, but it is my least preferred school. However, given my high priority, I would only end up here if all other options are unavailable.
